title: Bo Hampton
description: "I wanted to do Han Solo on Dagobah mainly because I like the character and I like the planet," explains Bo Hampton. "Where else but in science fiction can you make a statement like that?" After assisting his former teacher, Will Eisner, back in the late '70s, Hampton broke into the comics biz with limited work for DC's WITCHING HOUR. Recent projects include LEGEND OF SLEEPY HOLLOW for Tundra and UTHER, THE HALF-DEAD KING for Tundra, U.K
